title: Shopify Store Radar output
description: The scan results — one dataset of products with price, stock and change info, plus a per-run summary of what each store returned or why it failed.

products.title: Products
products.description: One item per product: price, compare-at price, discount %, variant-level stock and the change since the previous run.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Per-store product counts, change counts and failure reasons (non-UCP store, blocked IP, throttled).
